audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track. The full video would use sparse low ambience; none is included here.
limitations: Reflections are a single re-marched bounce (40 steps), not path-traced; AO is a 4-sample SDF approximation.
Internal resolution is 768x432 upsampled with linear filtering, which softens fine fractal detail.
Fog is analytic exponential distance fog toward #080A0C, not volumetric scattering; the spark halo is an analytic glow.
Material is an illustrative metallic/glossy approximation built from the #F2EEE5 foreground token, not a measured BRDF.
Mandelbulb distance estimates with clamped iteration count can show minor stepping artifacts at grazing angles.
Landscape fold is only hinted (uLandscape 0.35); the full landscape, sunset and sculptural SDF lettering from a glyph distance texture are not in this preview.
If EXT_color_buffer_float is unavailable the render target falls back to 8-bit with x/(1+x) encoding, adding slight banding.
Three.js 0.186 is bundled locally by esbuild into three.min.js (window.THREE); the scene, GLSL raymarcher, WebGLRenderTarget pass and GSAP timeline are inline in index.html.

Copy uses an @font-face 'PreviewSerif' resolved via local() system fonts (Didot, Bodoni 72, Georgia, Times New Roman); exact face depends on the render host. Reading bands behind copy resolve to the exact background.
